subject: Dominator
author: ZombieTron
body:
OK, so I guess you only have a PS2. In which case I would say get Burnout Dominator. Revenge is a great game but as it is no longer online on PS2 you will be missing out on that side of the game, whereas Dominator has no online components so is probably the best purchase for you.

--- The Original and the Best ---
